title: Classic Mini and modern MINI: what was kept and what was lost
author: Caramagnols
excerpt: The modern MINI kept visual codes and playful identity, but lost much of the classic car smallness and mechanical simplicity.
content:
Comparing the classic Mini and the modern MINI requires separating visible codes from physical experience. The modern car can recall the original without being the same kind of object.

Practical final checks

The transition is detailed in the BMW-era change. The late classic cars are covered in the final classic Mini versions.
